C0223.title: Man Sentenced for Fraudulently Selling App Memberships on Second-Hand Platform
C0223.summary: From late 2023 to February 2024, Zeng used second-hand platform accounts verified under other people’s real names to falsely sell learning-app memberships, disguising short-term top-ups as two- or three-year memberships and defrauding victims including Mu and Gong of RMB 29,843. Wuhua Court held that the conduct constituted fraud, sentenced Zeng to one year in prison suspended for eighteen months, imposed an RMB 2,000 fine, and ordered restitution of illegal proceeds.
